name: Amel

grounded_traits: skeptical of beautiful but unusable paperwork
personality.voice: Uses numbers to challenge a schedule, not to make the spreadsheet feel kind; insists supplies arrive before people need them.

relationships.Jasper: Requires specific arrival times and verifies receipts for proposed deliveries versus delivered water.
relationships.Katara: Helps document actual clinic and shelter needs without exposing names.
relationships.Aang: Rejects a long-term plan that depends on the Avatar carrying everything.

source_boundary: Story-original Lanternweald resident. She is not assumed to be a member of any off-world franchise.
writer_rules: Keep supporting characters independent of Jasper's romantic arcs.
Use manuscript-grounded roles and preserve personal agency, labor and privacy.
Do not infer undocumented age, family, certifications or homeworld.
